eg.t: Statement by the Eurogroup President on the nominations for the post of ECB President

qz.t: E.U. ministers are pushing for a December deal on ECB’s next president

reu.t: EU leaders aim to appoint new ECB chief in December, official says

updates.t: Two candidates are nominated to succeed Christine Lagarde: Pablo Hernández de Cos of Spain and Klaas Knot of the Netherlands. Euro area finance ministers reviewed the nominations on 9 November. EU leaders aim to decide at their summit on 17–18 December.
updates.why: The winner will lead the ECB’s interest rate decisions after Lagarde leaves on 7 February 2027.
